sentences.text:
For the O.P. No. 2 : Mr. Shekhar Pd. Gupta, Advocate
 ------
04/ 10.04.2024:

Heard learned counsel for the petitioners, learned counsel for the State and learned counsel for the O.P. No.2.
2.

The petitioners are apprehending their arrest in connection with Tandwa P.S. Case No. 196 of 2023, registered under sections 341, 323, 307, 498(A), 34 of I.P.C under section 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, pending in the Court of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Chatra.
3. Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that petitioner no. 1 is father-in-law, petitioner no. 2 is mother-in-law and petitioner no.3 is sister-in-law of the O.P. No. 2.

He submits that the case is registered under section 498A I.P.C. and under section 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act and there are general and omnibus allegation against the petitioners and the allegation if any of torture that is against the husband who is not petitioner at present.

4. Learned counsel for the State opposes the prayer on the ground that demand of dowry is there.
5.
Learned counsel for the O.P. No.2 opposes the prayer and submits that petitioners are inlaws of the informant and have demanded dowry.

6. Considering that the petitioners are inlaws of the informant and there are general and omnibus allegation against the petitioners and allegation of torture is against husband who is not petitioner at present, I am inclined to grant anticipatory bail to the petitioners.

Accordingly, the above named petitioners are directed to surrender before the learned court within three weeks from today and in the event of their surrender / arrest, the petitioners shall be released on bail, on furnishing bail bonds of Rs. 25,000/- (twenty five thousand)each with two sureties of the like amount each, to the Narayan Rana vs The State Of Jharkhand & Anr. ..... ...
